desc.ian_image_library:title: Leucaena leucocephala (White Leadtree)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Known as Koa haole (foreign koa) in Hawaii, or leucaena, is abundant as a weed in dry lowlands of Hawaii, often forming dense thickets in lowlands and lower mountain slopes of 2500 ft (762 m) altitude.
